# MDD Sim Gateway v1.9.4

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- **本版本有一个新功能和两条短信修复。**新功能是按线路自定义 SIP User-Agent，给那些按终端
  白名单校验、对陌生 User-Agent 直接回 403 的运营商用；两条修复都在蜂窝短信接收路径上。
- **默认身份没有变化。**不填写 User-Agent 的线路仍然以 `MDD-Sim-Gateway` 标识，已有线路升级
  后行为完全不变。只有显式填了才会覆盖。
- **本版本会自动删除运营商的 MMS 通知。**这类通知以 WAP Push 形式走短信通道，没有可读正文，
  网关也从不下载 MMS，留着只会一直占用模块/SIM 的短信存储直到存满、再也收不到新短信。如果
  你需要保留原始对象排查问题，在 `settings` 下设置 `drop_mms_wap_push: false`。
- **本版本改动了 Engine。**升级时必须同时更新 Control 与 Engine 镜像，不能只替换控制面；
  手动升级请执行 `sudo ./install.sh reload`，不要加 `--no-engines`。
- **本版本暂不开放自动安装。**自动更新通道仍保持在 v1.9.1，v1.9.2 起的各版本都需要手动升级。
  待实机验证确认后再开放。

### 1. v1.9.4 本次小版本更新

**控制面与引擎**

- **部分运营商的 IMS 按 User-Agent 白名单校验，不在名单里 REGISTER 直接返回 403，改 IMEI 没用。**
  IMEI 只会出现在 ePDG 的 DEVICE_IDENTITY 里，而 User-Agent 是另一个字段，此前在控制面和引擎
  中都写死为 `MDD-Sim-Gateway`，界面和配置都改不了，受影响的线路没有任何办法注册上去。现在
  可以在「高级 IMS 身份」里按线路填写；留空仍用默认值。该值会直接写进 `pjsip.conf`，因此会被
  规整为单行可打印 ASCII 并截断到 64 字符——换行会让一条线路往 Asterisk 配置里追加内容，而
  `;` 会被 Asterisk 当作注释起点，把后面的内容静默截掉。
  （[#83](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/83)）

**控制面**

- **长短信会被导入两次，第一条内容显示为 `--`。** 多段短信在所有分段到齐之前，`mmcli` 会把
  正文渲染成占位符 `--`，接收扫描把它当正文存了下来；等剩余分段到达、正文拼完整后，由于导入
  指纹包含正文，同一条短信又被当作新消息导入了一次。现在占位符和 ModemManager 的 `receiving`
  状态都算作「正文尚不可读」，不再导入。
  （[#84](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/84)）
- **运营商的 MMS 通知会一直占用模块/SIM 的短信存储。** 它经短信通道以 WAP Push 送达，没有可读
  正文，只有二进制 WSP 负载；网关从不下载 MMS，因此既显示不了也转发不了，也没有别的流程会消费
  它——在经常收到 MMS 的卡上，存储最终会被占满，新短信再也收不进来。现在识别后会从 ModemManager
  删除。识别同时要求正文不可读且带有标准的 `application/vnd.wap.mms-message` 标记，因此不依赖
  任何运营商的发送号码、SMSC 或 MMSC 地址。
  （[#85](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/85)）

### 2. v1.9 功能概览

- 线路可自定义向运营商标识的 SIP User-Agent，默认仍为 `MDD-Sim-Gateway`。
- SIM 访问支持 APDU-level 响应的读卡器与 T=1 卡，覆盖 SELECT 与 READ 全流程。
- 国家出口选择器可按中英文国家名与两位国家代码搜索，并支持键盘选择。
- 重命名运行中的 SIM 线路不再重建 IKE 与 Asterisk 引擎；改动运行参数仍会重启线路以生效。
- 手动更新可在最近五个正式版本中选择，便于回退或切换版本。
- 换出口的判定只在隧道于网络层得不到应答时归咎于出口；运营商侧的授权拒绝不再换节点
  （v1.9.2 起）。

本版本需要同时更新 Control 与 Engine。Engine 的配置渲染代码有变更，发布流程会为 arm64
和 amd64 重新构建并校验镜像。

## English

### 0. Important notes

- **This release adds one feature and fixes two SMS problems.** The feature is a per-line SIP
  User-Agent, for carriers that check the terminal against a whitelist and answer 403 to one
  they do not recognise. Both fixes are on the cellular SMS receive path.
- **The default identity is unchanged.** A line with no User-Agent set still identifies as
  `MDD-Sim-Gateway`, so existing lines behave exactly as before. Only an explicit value
  overrides it.
- **This release deletes carrier MMS notifications.** They arrive on the SMS channel as a WAP
  Push with no readable text, and the gateway never retrieves MMS, so one left in place holds
  modem/SIM SMS storage until it fills and no new SMS can arrive. Set `drop_mms_wap_push:
  false` under `settings` to keep the raw objects for troubleshooting.
- **The engine changed in this release.** Update Control and Engine together; for a manual
  upgrade run `sudo ./install.sh reload` without `--no-engines`.
- **Automatic installation stays closed.** The auto-update channels remain on v1.9.1, so every
  release from v1.9.2 on must be installed manually. The channels move once this is confirmed
  on real hardware.

### 1. Changed in v1.9.4

**Control plane and engine**

- **Some carriers gate IMS registration on a User-Agent whitelist and answer 403 to a terminal
  they do not recognise; configuring the IMEI does not help.** The IMEI only reaches the ePDG's
  DEVICE_IDENTITY, while the User-Agent is a separate field that was hardcoded to
  `MDD-Sim-Gateway` in both the control plane and the engine, reachable from neither the UI nor
  the config — an affected line had no way to register. It can now be set per line under
  Advanced IMS identity; left empty the default still applies. The value is written straight
  into `pjsip.conf`, so it is reduced to a single line of printable ASCII and capped at 64
  characters: a newline would let a line append arbitrary Asterisk configuration, and Asterisk
  reads `;` as the start of a comment, which would silently truncate the header
  ([#83](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/83)).

**Control plane**

- **A multi-part SMS was imported twice, the first copy reading `--`.** Until every part has
  arrived, `mmcli` renders the text as its placeholder `--`, and the receive scanner stored
  that as the body; when the remaining parts arrived and the text was assembled, the same
  message was imported again, because the import fingerprint covers the body. The placeholder
  and ModemManager's `receiving` state now both count as "no readable text yet"
  ([#84](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/84)).
- **A carrier MMS notification held modem/SIM SMS storage indefinitely.** It arrives over the
  SMS channel as a WAP Push with no readable text and a binary WSP payload; the gateway never
  retrieves MMS, so it can neither be shown nor forwarded and nothing else ever consumes it —
  on a SIM that receives them regularly the storage eventually fills and no new SMS can arrive.
  It is now deleted from ModemManager once recognised. Recognition requires both an unreadable
  text and the standard `application/vnd.wap.mms-message` marker, so it keys on no carrier's
  sender number, SMSC or MMSC host
  ([#85](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/issues/85)).

### 2. v1.9 feature overview

- A line can present its own SIP User-Agent to the carrier; the default remains
  `MDD-Sim-Gateway`.
- SIM access supports APDU-level readers and T=1 cards across SELECT and READ.
- The country exit picker searches by English and Chinese country names and two-letter codes,
  with keyboard selection.
- Renaming a running SIM line no longer rebuilds the IKE and Asterisk engines; changing runtime
  parameters still restarts the line so they take effect.
- Manual updates can select any of the last five official releases, for rollback or switching.
- Exit attribution blames the node only for a tunnel that went unanswered on the network;
  carrier-side authorization refusals no longer move the node (since v1.9.2).

This release updates Control and Engine together. The engine's configuration rendering changed,
so the release workflow rebuilds and verifies both arm64 and amd64 images.
